title: Structured Extrema Errors in Classical Surrogates for Viscous Burgers: A Physics-Consistent Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the local errors of classical machine-learning surrogate models, which approximate the time evolution of the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation. Four models are compared on the same prediction task, using the spatial grid values directly: radial basis function (RBF) kernel ridge regression (KRR), linear Ridge, ExtraTrees, and Random Forests. Across all four models, the one-step residual, defined here as the true value minus the predicted value at each grid point, forms clear curved branches near predicted maxima and minima. A more detailed analysis of KRR shows that these errors are much more strongly related to the second spatial derivative, which measures local curvature, than to the first spatial derivative. Near a smooth extremum, predicted value and curvature form a local two-branch fold. Under our local curvature-based model of the residual, this fold predicts a leading-order near-parabolic relation between predicted

translated_title: 粘性Burgers方程经典代理模型中的结构化极值误差：一种物理一致的解释
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2609.07952v1）：我们研究了经典机器学习代理模型在逼近一维粘性Burgers方程时间演化时的局部误差。四种模型在同一预测任务上直接使用空间网格值进行比较：径向基函数（RBF）核岭回归（KRR）、线性岭回归、ExtraTrees和随机森林。在所有四种模型中，单步残差（定义为每个网格点上真实值减去预测值）在预测的极大值和极小值附近形成清晰的弯曲分支。对KRR的更详细分析表明，这些误差与衡量局部曲率的二阶空间导数的关联远强于与一阶空间导数的关联。在光滑极值附近，预测值和曲率形成局部双分支折叠结构。在我们基于局部曲率的残差模型下，这种折叠结构预测了预测值之间的领先阶近抛物线关系。
tldr: 该研究发现经典机器学习代理模型在逼近粘性Burgers方程时，其单步残差在极值附近呈现结构化分支，且误差与局部曲率（二阶空间导数）的关联远强于与梯度（一阶导数）的关联，并提出了一个物理一致的基于曲率的残差模型来解释这一现象。
en_tdlr: Classical ML surrogate models for the viscous Burgers equation exhibit structured residual error branches near extrema that correlate far more strongly with local curvature than with the gradient, explained by a physics-consistent curvature-based model predicting a near-parabolic relation between predicted value and curvature.
